title: Metro Aviation introduces MetroAero Sim at AMTC 2026
summary: MetroAero Sim is an advanced avionics simulation platform designed to provide realistic, scenario-based rotorcraft training.
body_markdown:
Metro Aviation is introducing MetroAero Sim, an advanced avionics simulation platform designed to provide realistic, scenario-based rotorcraft training.


The new training solution will be on display at Booth 639 during the Air Medical Transport Conference (AMTC), October 26-28 in Fort Worth, Texas.


Designed for flight schools, air medical operators, and aviation training organizations, MetroAero Sim bridges the gap between classroom instruction and traditional flight simulation. The platform allows pilots to practice cockpit procedures, avionics management, and system operations in an interactive, controlled environment.


MetroAero Sim integrates multiple aircraft systems, including advanced autopilot functions, terrain awareness and warning systems, navigation displays, and aircraft system monitoring. The platform replicates the interaction between these systems, allowing pilots to develop familiarity with complex cockpit workflows and practice responding to a variety of flight conditions.


The system also supports repeatable training scenarios, giving instructors the ability to reinforce procedures, evaluate performance, and build pilot proficiency. Its configurable architecture allows the platform to accommodate multiple aircraft types and training requirements.


“MetroAero Sim gives pilots an opportunity to build confidence and familiarity with aircraft systems without the high cost of using the actual aircraft, an expensive FTD, or full motion simulator,” said Metro president and CEO Mike Stanberry. “It’s another tool to support training, reinforce procedures, and help pilots make the most of their time in the aircraft.”


MetroAero Sim is intended for procedural and systems familiarization training and is not a certified flight training device. Its compact design and flexible configuration make it a practical addition to existing aviation training programs.


AMTC attendees can experience the Metro Aero Sim H135 Trainer at Metro Aviation’s Booth 639.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Metro Aviation.*
